description: Look up what AlterLab has measured about a domain across many customers' recent unauthenticated scrapes: success_rate, typical_tier, typical_cost_microcents and typical_cost_usd, median_latency_ms, antibot_vendor, and common_failures (code, share, retryable), each with its sample size in field_samples. Use before scraping an unfamiliar site to budget credits and set expectations; it is read-only and informational, AlterLab still chooses the tier, proxy and pace for every request. A field with too few measured samples is omitted, never estimated. An unknown or unpublished domain returns known: false and the free estimate path (alterlab_estimate_cost). Free and keyless, no credits are spent, and a call never scrapes the site.

domain.description: Hostname only, e.g. example.com (no scheme, path or query)
